svg.text: GPIO4 sensors / GPIO5 heater / GPIO6 fan — 3.3 V sensor bus; proposed 5 V trigger drive
DQ_BUS — no capacitor from DQ to GND
Same net labels are electrically connected. All GND symbols share PSU negative; GPIO pins never receive 5 V.
U4 is a proposed addition: AOD4184A low on-resistance is specified at 4.5/10 V gate drive, not at ESP32 3.3 V.
Direct GPIO → module TRIG is an alternative only after verifying the exact board at 3.3 V, load current and startup.
Sensor orientation: flat marked face toward you, legs down → left GND, middle DQ, right VDD. Confirm your actual package.
MYMS / Rev A / 2026-11-26 — Proposal; verify actual module terminals, ratings and startup behavior. Not a PCB layout.
